question: **Direction: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is **"Conspirasy."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct spelling of the word is **"conspiracy."**
 
• The word **"conspiracy"** means a secret plan by a group to do something unlawful or harmful. (अनुचित या गै़र-क़ानूनी काम की गुप्‍त योजना; षड्‌यंत्र, साज़िश)
